
# OPERAVA MailDesk — LLM Implementation Reference

This file is the machine-readable source of truth for coding agents working in this repository.

## Authority

Follow the current source code and current database migration over historical/reference HTML artifacts.

Do not invent routes, tables, UI features, integrations, or deployment workflows that are not present in the current source.

## Product

OPERAVA MailDesk is a secure, garden-themed email workspace.

Production browser entry point: index.html
Brand asset: operava_exact_transparent.png

## Current stack

- Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend
- Supabase Auth for email/password authentication
- Cloudflare Worker API
- Supabase Postgres + RLS
- Resend API for server-side email delivery
- Signed Resend webhook ingestion
- Cloudflare Pages is the intended static hosting target

## Current frontend

Files:
- index.html
- app.css
- app.js
- app-config.js

The browser configuration contains only public Supabase URL/anon-key information and the Worker URL.

Current UI flow:
1. sign in
2. load mailbox
3. filter current mailbox statuses exposed by the UI
4. compose
5. send
6. sign out

Do not claim the UI has attachments, boards, threads, rich-text editing, live Realtime updates, or a full folder system unless the code is changed to implement them.

## Current Worker routes

- GET /health
- POST /webhooks/resend
- authenticated GET /emails
- authenticated POST /emails

There are currently no /boards/* routes.

## Authentication

The browser authenticates with Supabase Auth.

Protected Worker routes require a bearer access token and verify the current user through Supabase Auth.

Never expose:
- Supabase service-role key
- Resend API key
- Resend webhook secret

## Current database

Migration: supabase/migrations/0001_maildesk.sql

Objects:
- enum mailbox_status
- table emails
- table email_events

RLS is enabled. User-owned email records are restricted to the authenticated user.

The migration includes the emails table in the Realtime publication, but the current frontend does not subscribe to Realtime.

There is currently no production schema for:
- profiles
- folders
- templates
- sticky notes
- boards
- attachments

## Resend

Sending is performed by the Worker.

Webhook requests are validated using the configured Resend/Svix signing secret before accepted events are persisted.

Current mailbox-status mapping in the Worker includes:
- email.sent → sent
- email.bounced → failed
- email.complained → failed

Do not describe this as complete open/click/delivery state synchronization.

## Deployment

Worker configuration lives in worker/wrangler.toml.

Use Cloudflare Worker secrets for server credentials.

The root frontend is static and can be deployed through Cloudflare Pages.

## Validation

Run:

    node --check app.js
    node --check worker/src/index.js

Do not claim an end-to-end test suite exists.

## Historical/reference artifacts

These files may contain concepts or code that are not part of the current implementation:
- login_page.html
- mailbox_pages.html
- operava-maildesk-backend-stack.html

They are reference artifacts only.

## Planned features

Potential future work may include:
- Supabase Storage attachments
- board/sticky-note workspace
- richer mailbox organization
- frontend Realtime subscriptions
- richer delivery tracking
- automated GitHub deployment workflow

Planned features must not be presented as implemented until source code and schema support them.
